source.author: verg
source.text: Ille, oculis postquam saevi monimenta doloris exuviasque hausit, furiis accensus et ira terribilis, Tune hinc spoliis indute meorum eripiare mihi?
source.text_original: Ille, oculis postquam saevi monimenta doloris / exuviasque hausit, furiis accensus et ira / terribilis, 'Tune hinc spoliis indute meorum / eripiare mihi?
source.text_english: He, after his eyes had drunk in the memorials of his cruel grief and the spoils, kindled by frenzy and terrible in anger, said: “Then must you, decked out here in the spoils of my men, be snatched away from me?”
